"MASTER GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT — COMPLETE BLOX FRUITS-STYLE OPEN WORLD RPG

1. MAIN OBJECTIVE

Create a fully playable, highly detailed 3D anime-inspired open-world pirate adventure RPG inspired by the complete gameplay systems of Roblox Blox Fruits, with content coverage up to the Halloween 2026 Update 30.1 (Hellfire Gas update).

The game must include a huge explorable world, three seas, islands, NPCs, quests, bosses, fruits, transformations, combat systems, weapons, fighting styles, races, accessories, events, progression, trading, and multiplayer systems.

Do not create a small demo or a simple prototype and call it complete.

Build a proper, functional game with interconnected systems.

Use original assets, models, sounds and interface artwork rather than copying proprietary game files.

2. WORLD AND MAP

Create three complete seas:

- First Sea
- Second Sea
- Third Sea

Every sea must have:

- Its own unique islands.
- Accurate island geography and recognizable environmental themes.
- Mountains, beaches, forests, caves, buildings and hidden locations.
- NPC spawn locations.
- Quest givers.
- Boss locations.
- Shops and dealers.
- Boat spawn points.
- Safe zones.
- Secret areas.
- Teleport locations.
- Hidden collectibles.
- Exploration rewards.

Every island must be explorable, not just a decorative background.

Include:

- Ocean rendering.
- Realistic water movement.
- Day and night cycle.
- Dynamic weather.
- Sunlight and shadows.
- Moon phases.
- Fog.
- Underwater environments.
- Ambient environmental sounds.
- Sea exploration.
- Islands visible from a distance.

3. PLAYER SYSTEM

Create a complete player progression system.

Player information:

- Username.
- Character appearance.
- Level.
- XP.
- Health.
- Energy.
- Beli.
- Fragments.
- Bounty/Honor.
- Race.
- Equipped fruit.
- Equipped fighting style.
- Equipped sword.
- Equipped gun.
- Accessories.
- Mastery levels.
- Stats.

Create a complete character customization system.

Include:

- Character movement.
- Running.
- Walking.
- Jumping.
- Double jumping where applicable.
- Dashing.
- Swimming.
- Falling.
- Landing animations.
- Different attack animations.
- Hit reactions.
- Death and respawn.
- Character camera tracking.

4. COMPLETE LEVEL AND STAT SYSTEM

Create a level progression system from level 1 to level 3000.

Include:

- XP requirements.
- Quest-based XP.
- Enemy XP.
- Boss XP.
- Level-up notifications.
- Stat points.
- Stat reset functionality.

Stats:

- Melee.
- Defense.
- Sword.
- Gun.
- Blox Fruit.

Every stat must affect gameplay correctly.

5. COMPLETE BLOX FRUIT SYSTEM

Implement a complete fruit collection system.

Include all fruit categories:

- Common.
- Uncommon.
- Rare.
- Legendary.
- Mythical.

Implement every fruit with:

- Unique appearance.
- Unique icon.
- Description.
- Rarity.
- Price.
- Mastery.
- Individual abilities.
- Cooldowns.
- Energy requirements.
- M1 attacks where applicable.
- Unique animations.
- Sound effects.
- Particle effects.
- Damage effects.
- Transformation systems.
- Flight or movement abilities where applicable.
- Awakening or mutation systems where applicable.

Include all original fruit families and their distinct mechanics, including:
Rocket, Spin, Blade, Spring, Bomb, Smoke, Spike, Flame, Falcon, Ice, Sand, Dark, Diamond, Light, Rubber, Barrier, Ghost, Magma, Quake, Buddha, Love, Spider, Sound, Phoenix, Portal, Rumble, Pain, Blizzard, Gravity, Mammoth, T-Rex, Dough, Shadow, Venom, Control, Spirit, Dragon, Leopard, Kitsune, Gas and Magnet.

Do not make all fruits behave similarly. Every fruit must have its own identity.

6. HELLFIRE GAS — COMPLETE MUTATION SYSTEM

This is one of the highest-priority features.

Implement Hellfire as a Mythical mutation of Gas.

Hellfire must have its own:

- Fruit icon.
- Inventory artwork.
- Description.
- Mutation identification.
- Special orange fire effects.
- Unique idle animation.
- M1 attacks.
- Five abilities.
- Mastery progression.
- Transformation.
- Special meter (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a fully playable, anime-inspired open-world pirate RPG with interconnected progression, exploration, combat, and fruit systems, prioritizing Hellfire Gas mutation.
- Use original assets and provide a playable browser game without claiming a small demo is complete.

## Requirements
- Three seas with explorable islands, NPCs, quests, bosses, shops, safe zones, secrets, boats, and exploration rewards.
- Character movement, combat, levels 1–3000, XP, stats, currencies, inventory, races, and progression.
- Cover the requested fruit families and distinguish their mechanics; Hellfire Gas should have unique visuals, mutation identity, five abilities, mastery, transformation, and a meter.
- Responsive desktop/mobile controls; user requested no clarification questions and a brief note of assumptions on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original Three.js browser RPG named “Sea of Embers,” using procedural geometry and UI rather than proprietary assets.
- Kept the implementation self-contained in plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript with CDN Three.js.
- Implemented Hellfire Gas with six hotbar moves (M1 plus five abilities), mutation artwork/UI, transformation meter, and mastery progression.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a responsive game interface with HUD, contract tracker, panels, hotbar, and mobile touch controls.
- Added procedural island scenes, NPCs, enemies/bosses, sea selection, combat, XP/leveling, stats, inventory, and local save persistence.
- Added a fruit archive listing the requested fruit families and Hellfire-specific details.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Browser verification and visual fixes have not been completed.
- The local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser capture/inspection remains to be done.
- Changes are uncommitted.

- (none)

- `style.css`: Responsive interface and visual styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js world, gameplay systems, combat, progression, persistence.

- The repository initially contained no game implementation.
- Current build is an original playable slice, not the full exhaustive game scope described by the user; avoid claiming all requested content is complete.
- The local server command is `python3 -m http.server 3002`.

## Objective
- Build an original, playable anime-inspired open-world pirate RPG with interconnected exploration, combat, and progression.
- Prioritize Hellfire Gas as a distinct mutation while accurately describing the delivered scope.

## Requirements
- Include three seas, explorable islands, quests, bosses, shops, safe zones, exploration, boats, and progression systems.
- Support movement, combat, levels 1–3000, XP, stats, currencies, inventory, races, and fruit families with distinct mechanics.
- Give Hellfire Gas its own mutation identity, visuals, five abilities plus M1, mastery, transformation, and meter.
- Support responsive desktop/mobile controls; note assumptions on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built “Sea of Embers,” an original Three.js browser RPG using procedural geometry and UI rather than proprietary assets.
- Kept the implementation in plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript with Three.js from a CDN.
- Implemented Hellfire Gas as six hotbar moves (M1 plus five abilities), with a transformation meter and mastery progression.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive HUD, panels, hotbar, contract tracker, and mobile touch controls.
- Implemented procedural island scenes, NPCs, enemies/bosses, sea selection, combat, XP/leveling, stats, inventory, and local save persistence.
- Added fruit archive listing fruit families and Hellfire-specific details.
- Fixed enemy grouping and placed player spawn near the Harbor Guide; prevented enemies aggroing in the safe harbor.
- Added empty data-URI favicon.
- Browser checks passed for movement, guide interaction/quest acceptance, fruit archive, three-sea chart, mobile controls, local save, and no page errors.
- Ran `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` successfully.
- Saved and inspected `screenshots/sea-of-embers.jpg` at 1024×768.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further work is requested, continue from the current uncommitted game implementation and report its scope as a playable slice, not a complete exhaustive game.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, panels, controls, and hotbar.
- `style.css`: Responsive interface and visual styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js world, gameplay systems, combat, progression, persistence, and safe-zone behavior.
- `screenshots/sea-of-embers.jpg`: Latest inspected viewport screenshot.

## Important Context
- Repository initially contained no game implementation.
- Changes are uncommitted; new project files are untracked.
- Later seas are level-gated; the world chart lists three seas and nine islands.
- The quest guide interaction was verified after moving the spawn closer to the guide.
